name: Treasures
overview: Scripture teaches that true treasure is not found in earthly possessions, which are subject to decay and theft, but in the fear of the LORD and salvation, which provide stability and strength (Isaiah 33:6; Matthew 6:19). Jesus emphasizes that where one’s treasure is, there the heart will be also, warning against serving both God and mammon (Matthew 6:21, 24). The kingdom of heaven is likened to a hidden treasure worth sacrificing all to obtain, promising eternal reward for those who forsake earthly wealth to follow Christ and store up treasure in heaven (Matthew 13:44; 19:21).
